title: Version 3 Final Production Release Preflight, Payment Credentials Ready-State & Launch Candidate V3
objective: Prepare the entire NIHOMI platform for live commercial launch. Configure production payment credentials ready-state (bKash/Nagad/SSLCommerz secure environment variables hydration schema), verify aiCostGuard rate limiting and token safety, run preflight security and performance audit across all 15 routes, and execute the final production release candidate verification suite.
in_scope: Configure production payment credentials environment loader and ready-state validation in server/payment-security.ts and server/routes/payment.ts for bKash merchant integration.
Verify aiCostGuard quota enforcement, token limits, and rate limiting across all Nomi Sensei endpoints.
Execute full preflight audit across all 15 V3 routes (landing, journey, dashboard, kana, curriculum, lesson, exam, workos, rirekisho, pricing, founder, terms, privacy, refund, legacy).
Author automated end-to-end launch verification suite scripts/test-v3-wp06-production-preflight.cjs with 100% green assertions.
Generate final Release Candidate V3 artifact and live readiness audit documentation.
out_of_scope: Hardcoding actual live secret payment keys into source control (must reside strictly in private .env / Cloudflare deployment secrets).
Modifying canonical JLPT curriculum definitions or lattice rules.
acceptance_criteria: Payment system is ready for immediate live credential input with zero runtime errors.
All AI endpoints protected by aiCostGuard with sliding window rate limiting and quota verification.
Zero TypeScript or build errors (npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build).
Automated preflight test suite passes with 100% green assertions and captures screenshot evidence across all critical user flows.
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify zero type errors.
Run npm run build to verify production bundling.
Verify payment callback mock cycle, aiCostGuard middleware intercept, and release checklist.
risks: Live payment gateway response timeout during sandbox/production handshake (mitigated by resilient fallback and transaction retry logging).
